name: CaseCalcVar
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "calc-var" (custom-properties). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: padding-left: calc(var(--cf-space-2) * 2)
